description: G-buffer smoke (developer build: -Asi Release\ApexRadiance.asi), GB-01 to GB-04: the capability line, camera motion vectors, the scene's extra render targets written by the ps_3_0 and ps_2_x copies, the colour-coded views and Ambient Occlusion's two G-buffer consumers. Each variant is one load: one F8 picture with a still camera, then one minute of camera pan. -AB runs every variant in the order list; without it the motion view runs. Pass: no crash, the [GBuffer] and [AO] lines of the variant, a Scene line with patched draws and no failed bind, no shader, target or history error. Read after the run: the pictures (albedo: objects in their texture colour, and since GB-04 Sims' skin and clothes and the painted ground too instead of mid grey; normal: colours follow the surface; material and class: flat colours per object; unwritten: red where no copy wrote), the UI absent from every view, no trails behind glass or particles. ao-normals: Ambient Occlusion with the scene's shading normals, compared with the on load's picture: no dashed shade along counter tops and seams, no new dark rims. ao-temporal: the same with the temporal filter: during the pan no trails on walls, Sims and trees keep their shade without smearing (motion class 3 starts a new history), the restarts count small next to temporal.
